description: Transcribe the audio of any video/audio URL (YouTube, TikTok, podcasts, and 1000+ sites) to text with timestamped segments. Importly handles the download, audio extraction, and speech-to-text server-side — no yt-dlp or ffmpeg needed. Async: returns a jobId immediately; poll check_transcription for the transcript. Costs scale with media length; set maxCostDollars to cap spend on long media.

maxCostDollars.description: Abort with a quote if the estimated cost exceeds this cap

name: transcribe_media
